statement: Bhadra Yoga (Mercury in its own or exaltation sign, in a kendra from the Ascendant) carries eloquence, sharp intellect, and commercial or diplomatic skill — traditionally read as favoring communication, writing, or business.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
